verdict.rationale: Vanta's own API marketing and docs say the API can 'bulk assign owners to resources or mark them out of scope, or offload employees in batches' and 'automate bulk actions'. However, the cited API reference pages describe only single-item endpoints (create a control, delete a contract by ID, update a control's metadata). Upload-contract is rate-limited to 10 requests per minute, so bulk work may mean scripted loops rather than true batch operations. Missing for 10: documented bulk or batch API endpoints, any bulk-action capability in the UI or MCP, and independent hands-on corroboration of bulk operations.
